_comment: This file is NOT the published npm manifest. .github/workflows/release.yml is the single source of truth for the published package: it generates a fresh package.json (with main/types pointing at the real build/kotlin-webpack/js/productionExecutable/ output) and runs `npm publish` from there. The fields kept here exist only for repo tooling — `version` is validated by sync-versions.sh and release-checklist.sh and must stay in lockstep with gradle.properties VERSION_NAME. Do NOT add main/files/publishConfig back: they pointed at build/dist/js/... which the build never produces, so a manual `npm publish` from this directory shipped a broken tarball (#2058).
name: sceneview-web
description: SceneView for Web — 3D rendering with Filament.js (WebGL2/WASM). Same engine as SceneView Android.
